description: Launch material registry. 8 DR-007 launch materials at BP2; M12B expanded to 19 with 6 acoustic modder rows. M15 (2026-05-19) expanded to 50+ for the Active Material Kernel. M15C (2026-05-22) closes the schema gap: every material declares state (solid/liquid/gas/powder/plasma/energy_field) plus the full thermodynamic + chemistry block (density_kg_per_m3, specific_heat_capacity_j_per_kg_k, thermal_conductivity_w_per_m_k, melt/freeze/boil/ignition_temp_k, molar_mass_g_per_mol, toxicity, corrosiveness, radioactivity, electrical_conductivity, viscosity_pa_s, surface_tension_n_per_m, default/max_mass_per_tile_kg, reactions[], container_rules) using ONI + Stationeers wiki canonical numbers. Adds vacuum + alloys (aluminum, titanium, nickel, tin, lead, zinc, magnesium, lithium, sulfur, silver, platinum, tungsten, stainless_steel, brass, bronze) + radioactives (uranium_fuel_rod, depleted_uranium, plutonium) + exotics (diamond, graphene) + extra powders (phosphorite, cement_powder, flour, lime, quicklime, compost, dirt_fine) + plasmas (plasma_jet, welding_plasma) + energy fields (ir_signature, radioactive_emission). Schema stays v1; new fields are serde(default)-optional with the loader enforcing non-default on the five required fields.

materials.name: air
materials.description: Empty passable space.

materials.name: dirt
materials.description: Default destructible terrain. Digger carves easily; tether anchors.

materials.name: concrete
materials.description: Bunker wall. Rifle ineffective; drill/charge required.

materials.name: metal_nohook
materials.description: Hard undiggable metal (steel). Tether/anchor refuses with reason label. High stickiness — projectiles stick on failed penetration.

materials.name: hazard
materials.description: Damage-on-touch surface. Player must identify before contact.

materials.name: loose_fill
materials.description: Soft fill. Movement slowdown; low structural support.

materials.name: repair_fill
materials.description: Player-placed repair material. Creates cover and restores pathability.

materials.name: anchor
materials.description: Hard anchorable surface. Tether attaches; drill/charge can breach.

materials.name: wood
materials.description: M12B acoustic modder row. Warm-mid echo + moderate transmission loss.

materials.name: cloth
materials.description: M12B acoustic modder row. Dampened anechoic surface; curtains barely attenuate (~3 dB).

materials.name: glass
materials.description: M12B acoustic modder row. Bright short echo; ~18 dB transmission loss.

materials.name: cardboard
materials.description: M12B acoustic modder row. Dampened, ~6 dB transmission loss.

materials.name: snow
materials.description: M12B acoustic modder row. Nearly anechoic; thick blanket dampens.

materials.name: water
materials.description: M12B acoustic modder row. Warm-low; underwater listener gets 800 Hz cutoff + 60% volume per spec § Per-environment low-pass.

materials.name: sand
materials.description: M12B acoustic modder row. Nearly anechoic loose grains.

materials.name: ice
materials.description: M12B acoustic modder row. Bright short echo; brittle on impact.

materials.name: rock
materials.description: M12B acoustic modder row. Bright reflective surface; bigger than anchor.

materials.name: foam_insulation
materials.description: M12B acoustic modder row. Highly absorptive; the canonical anechoic-lining material.

materials.name: vegetation
materials.description: M12B acoustic modder row. Dampened broadband — leaves + foliage absorb mid-high.

materials.name: oil
materials.description: M15 active material. Flammable hydrocarbon liquid; ignites at ~535 K. Cascades fire at 0.8/s rate per M15 reaction registry.

materials.name: fuel
materials.description: M15 active material. Volatile petroleum fuel (kerosene/diesel grade). Ignites at ~483 K with high energy release.

materials.name: acid
materials.description: M15 active material. Corrosive liquid (H2SO4 analog). Reacts with iron/copper/zinc to form rust + hydrogen. Damages actors on contact.

materials.name: alkali
materials.description: M15 active material. Caustic base (NaOH analog). Neutralizes acid into brine. Player counter to acid hazards.

materials.name: blood
materials.description: M15 active material. Cools to coag_blood after ~30s air exposure. Forensic + medical tracking material.

materials.name: alcohol
materials.description: M15 active material. Ethanol-grade flammable solvent. Ignites at 638 K. Used by alchemy recipes.

materials.name: mercury
materials.description: M15 active material. Liquid metal at room temperature; conducts heat + electricity; toxic on contact.

materials.name: lava
materials.description: M15 active material. Molten basalt at 1373 K+. Flash-evaporates water to steam + obsidian crust.

materials.name: slime
materials.description: M15 active material. Viscous gel from bio-decomposition. Slows actors that step in it.

materials.name: basalt
materials.description: M15 solid. Volcanic igneous rock; product of lava cooling. Hard but blastable.

materials.name: brick
materials.description: M15 solid. Fired clay brick. Yields to brick yield strength 30 (M14F).

materials.name: marble
materials.description: M15 solid. Metamorphic limestone. Premium architectural stone.

materials.name: sandstone
materials.description: M15 solid. Sedimentary porous rock. Spalls to sand on impact.

materials.name: granite
materials.description: M15 solid. Hard intrusive igneous rock. Drill or blast required.

materials.name: coal
materials.description: M15 solid + alchemy reagent. Fossilized carbon. Burns to ash + CO2 at ~973 K. Iron+coal+heat → steel (alchemy).

materials.name: ore_iron
materials.description: M15 ore. Smelts to iron at 1811 K. Tier-1 crafting reagent.

materials.name: ore_gold
materials.description: M15 ore. Smelts to gold at 1337 K. Tier-2 crafting reagent.

materials.name: ore_copper
materials.description: M15 ore. Smelts to copper at 1358 K. Used in copper+zinc+heat alchemy (brass).

materials.name: ore_uranium
materials.description: M15 radioactive ore. Mild emission damage to nearby actors. Lead+ore_uranium+heat → uranium (alchemy).

materials.name: rust
materials.description: M15 solid. Iron oxide produced by acid+iron reaction. Loose, low integrity.

materials.name: mud
materials.description: M15 solid. Wet dirt; slows movement; spawns from dirt + water reaction.

materials.name: ash
materials.description: M15 powder. Combustion byproduct (wood/coal/oil). Disperses on wind.

materials.name: charcoal
materials.description: M15 solid. Pyrolyzed wood; intermediate combustion product. Burns slowly to ash.

materials.name: salt
materials.description: M15 powder. Crystalline NaCl. Dissolves in water → brine.

materials.name: sugar
materials.description: M15 powder. Crystalline sucrose. Dissolves in water → syrup.

materials.name: rubber
materials.description: M15 solid. Elastic polymer. High restitution.

materials.name: plastic
materials.description: M15 solid. Polyethylene-grade plastic. Melts at ~410 K; burns at ~620 K.

materials.name: leather
materials.description: M15 solid. Tanned hide. Dampens kinetic impacts.

materials.name: paper
materials.description: M15 solid. Cellulose paper. Ignites at ~506 K; instant cascade fuse.

materials.name: gunpowder
materials.description: M15 explosive powder. Detonates on spark + 5.0/s rate. Radius 2 tiles per kg.

materials.name: fabric
materials.description: M15 solid. Woven fabric bolt (denser than `cloth`). Ignites at ~510 K.

materials.name: steam
materials.description: M15 gas. Vaporized water (>373 K). Rises (lower density than air); condenses on cold surfaces.

materials.name: oxygen
materials.description: M15 gas. O2 — accelerator for combustion reactions.

materials.name: nitrogen
materials.description: M15 gas. Inert N2; majority of breathable air. Suppresses combustion.

materials.name: co2
materials.description: M15 gas. CO2 — combustion byproduct + suffocation hazard at high partial pressure.

materials.name: methane
materials.description: M15 gas. CH4 volatiles. Ignites at 573 K with O2 → CO2 + steam.

materials.name: hydrogen
materials.description: M15 gas. H2 — fast diffuser. Ignites at 773 K with O2 → steam + huge ΔH.

materials.name: nitrous_oxide
materials.description: M15 gas. N2O oxidizer. Alternative to O2 for combustion reactions.

materials.name: helium
materials.description: M15 gas. He — noble. Cryogenic coolant; layers above all other gases.

materials.name: ozone
materials.description: M15 gas. O3 — stronger oxidizer than O2. Lung irritant.

materials.name: ethanol_vapor
materials.description: M15 gas. C2H6O vapor. Flammable.

materials.name: chlorine
materials.description: M15 gas. Cl2 — toxic, dense, settles. Chemical weapon analog.

materials.name: ammonia
materials.description: M15 gas. NH3 — irritant + alkaline. Reacts with chlorine.

materials.name: smoke
materials.description: M15 gas. Combustion smoke. Visual obscurant + perception modifier (M17).

materials.name: electric_arc
materials.description: M15 plasma. Short-lived electric arc. Damages actors; conducts through water + metal.

materials.name: lightning
materials.description: M15 plasma. Massive electric discharge. Single-tick damage spike.

materials.name: fire_intense
materials.description: M15 plasma. Active combustion flame. Ignites adjacent flammable materials; extinguished by water/steam.

materials.name: polluted_water
materials.description: M15 liquid. Contaminated water; disease vector on contact.

materials.name: neutralized_brine
materials.description: M15 liquid. Salt + water produced by acid+alkali neutralization. Safe to walk through.

materials.name: iron
materials.description: M15 solid. Refined iron from ore_iron + heat. Reacts with acid (→ rust + H2).

materials.name: steel
materials.description: M15 alloy. Iron + coal + heat → steel (alchemy recipe). Harder than iron; standard armor metal.

materials.name: obsidian
materials.description: M15 solid. Volcanic glass; product of lava + water reaction.

materials.name: cloud
materials.description: M15B precipitation chain hint. Accumulated steam at altitude (M15B owns the full cycle); placeholder here so M15's phase registry can name the intermediate state.

materials.name: frozen_blood
materials.description: M15 solid. Blood crystallized at <273 K. Forensic vector.

materials.name: gold
materials.description: M15 solid. Refined gold from ore_gold + heat. Soft but dense.

materials.name: copper
materials.description: M15 solid. Refined copper from ore_copper + heat. High electrical + thermal conductivity.

materials.name: silanol
materials.description: M15 liquid (per spec § Liquids). Silicone hydroxide solvent; mildly toxic.

materials.name: milk
materials.description: M15 liquid (per spec § Liquids). Edible biological fluid.

materials.name: paint
materials.description: M15 liquid (per spec § Liquids). Pigmented coating; sticks to surfaces.

materials.name: coffee
materials.description: M15 liquid (per spec § Liquids). Caffeinated beverage.

materials.name: tea
materials.description: M15 liquid (per spec § Liquids). Infused tisane.

materials.name: vomit
materials.description: M15 liquid (per spec § Liquids). Gastric ejecta; disease vector.

materials.name: urine
materials.description: M15 liquid (per spec § Liquids). Excretion fluid.

materials.name: sweat
materials.description: M15 liquid (per spec § Liquids). Brine analog from exertion.

materials.name: pollutant_x
materials.description: M15 gas (per spec § Gases). Industrial pollutant; mild lung damage.

materials.name: sunlight
materials.description: M15 energy/light (per spec § Energy/Light). Radiation marker for daytime lighting.

materials.name: em_field
materials.description: M15 energy/light (per spec § Energy/Light). Electromagnetic field marker for EM weapons/scanners.

materials.name: magnetic_field
materials.description: M15 energy/light (per spec § Energy/Light). Magnetic field marker for compass / magnetic-weapon scope.

materials.name: rain
materials.description: M15B precipitation chain. Liquid droplet falling from a saturated cloud. Extinguishes fire (per M15 reactions) + flows back into puddles via cf-terrain liquid_flow.

materials.name: acid_droplet
materials.description: M15B Vulcan-ambient precipitation. Acid droplet from pollutant+steam cycle; corrodes metal_nohook via acid+iron→rust reaction.

materials.name: vacuum
materials.description: M15C exotic. Hard vacuum sentinel. Suffocates actors; sucks atmosphere through breaches (M19).

materials.name: aluminum
materials.description: M15C alloy. Lightweight metal; corrosion-resistant; structural use.

materials.name: titanium
materials.description: M15C alloy. High strength-to-weight; corrosion-resistant; aerospace.

materials.name: nickel
materials.description: M15C alloy. Magnetic; alloying agent for stainless steel.

materials.name: tin
materials.description: M15C alloy. Soft white metal; tinplate, solder, pewter base.

materials.name: lead
materials.description: M15C alloy. Heavy, toxic, malleable; radiation shielding + ballast.

materials.name: zinc
materials.description: M15C alloy. Galvanizing + brass component; reacts with acids.

materials.name: magnesium
materials.description: M15C alloy. Light, burns vigorously in air; flare-grade fuel.

materials.name: lithium
materials.description: M15C alloy. Lightest metal; battery anode + Li-ion electrolyte.

materials.name: sulfur
materials.description: M15C powder. Brimstone; oxidizes to SO2 on combustion.

materials.name: silver
materials.description: M15C alloy. Best electrical conductor; coinage + electronics.

materials.name: platinum
materials.description: M15C alloy. Inert + dense + catalyst grade; industrial precious metal.

materials.name: tungsten
materials.description: M15C alloy. Highest melting point of any metal; armor + projectiles.

materials.name: uranium_fuel_rod
materials.description: M15C exotic. Enriched U-235 fuel rod for reactors (M20). Severe radiation.

materials.name: depleted_uranium
materials.description: M15C exotic. DU armor + APFSDS penetrator core. Mild radioactivity.

materials.name: plutonium
materials.description: M15C exotic. Pu-239 fissile metal. Severe radiation + fire risk in air.

materials.name: silica
materials.description: M15C solid. Silicon dioxide; glassmaking raw material.

materials.name: quartz
materials.description: M15C solid. Crystalline SiO2; piezoelectric; sand source.

materials.name: slag
materials.description: M15C solid. Smelting byproduct; brittle low-grade rock.

materials.name: iridium
materials.description: M15C alloy. Densest stable metal; ultra-hard; corrosion-immune.

materials.name: niobium
materials.description: M15C alloy. Superalloy steel + superconductor at low temps.

materials.name: ceramic
materials.description: M15C solid. Alumina ceramic; armor + electrical insulator.

materials.name: cobalt
materials.description: M15C alloy. Magnetic; superalloy + Li-ion cathode component.

materials.name: insulite
materials.description: M15C solid (ONI parity). Extremely low thermal conductivity; insulator panel.

materials.name: polypropylene
materials.description: M15C polymer. PP plastic; chemical-resistant containers + tubing.

materials.name: stainless_steel
materials.description: M15C alloy. Iron + chromium + nickel; corrosion-resistant structural.

materials.name: brass
materials.description: M15C alloy. Copper + zinc; fittings, casings, low-spark tools.

materials.name: bronze
materials.description: M15C alloy. Copper + tin; bearings + bushings + historical weapons.

materials.name: diamond
materials.description: M15C exotic (M48+ unlock). Pure crystalline carbon; hardest natural material.

materials.name: graphene
materials.description: M15C exotic (M48+ unlock). Single-layer carbon mesh; ultra-stiff + conductive.

materials.name: phosphorite
materials.description: M15C powder. Phosphate-bearing rock; fertilizer + match heads.

materials.name: cement_powder
materials.description: M15C powder. Portland cement dry mix; hydrates into concrete.

materials.name: flour

materials.name: lime
materials.description: M15C powder. Calcium oxide; mortar binder; reacts exothermically with water.

materials.name: quicklime
materials.description: M15C powder. CaO before slaking; aggressive desiccant; burns skin.

materials.name: compost
materials.description: M15C powder. Decomposed organic matter; warm, nutrient-rich, fertilizes plants.

materials.name: dirt_fine
materials.description: M15C powder. Sifted topsoil; easy to dig + spread.

materials.name: plasma_jet
materials.description: M15C plasma. Focused plasma from torch / engine nozzle. Cuts metals at 20kK.

materials.name: welding_plasma
materials.description: M15C plasma. Arc-welding plasma at ~10kK. UV-bright; damages on direct contact.

materials.name: ir_signature
materials.description: M15C energy field. Infrared emission marker for thermal sensors + heat-seeking weapons.

materials.name: radioactive_emission
materials.description: M15C energy field. Gamma/beta/alpha emission marker. Damages actors per inverse-square.
